subject: design-technology
title: Nutrients
welcome_lead: Carbs, protein, fat, vitamins, minerals, water.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T food: the six main nutrients and what they do.
final_note: Food gives your body what it needs to grow and work.

concepts.def: Main energy source — sugars and starches.
Energy store and warmth, vital but small amount.
Tiny nutrient for body to work well.
Element like iron, needed in tiny amounts.

walkthroughs.body_html: Carbohydrates give your main energy — bread, pasta, rice. Fats are concentrated energy and protect organs — oils, butter, nuts. Both are essential in balance.
Protein builds and repairs muscle, skin, organs. Sources: meat, fish, eggs, beans, lentils, tofu. Active people need more.
Vitamins (C, D, B, etc.) and minerals (iron, calcium) are needed in small amounts but are vital. Plus fibre for digestion and water for everything.
